chunks: It appears that what is meant by al-Nawadir are uncommon reports that are not gathered under a chapter and are dispersed. The term may also be applied to irregular narrations.

key_terms.بَابٌ: a chapter heading under which reports are organized
key_terms.مُتَفَرِّقَةً: dispersed or scattered rather than grouped together
key_terms.ٱلنَّوَادِرِ: uncommon or rare reports in hadith compilation

ai.seo_question: What does al-Nawadir mean in hadith literature?
ai.summary: This passage explains the meaning of the term al-Nawadir in hadith literature. It refers to reports that are scattered and not collected under a single chapter, and it may also be used for anomalous narrations.
